summary: Flat start of a narrow lane where cars park; homes about 19-22 m away.
reasons: Cars and a van parked in this lane

best_section.where: East kerb just up the lane from the Orchard Terrace corner

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 19 m away at the bend, 22 m beyond; heavy tree cover hides the houses, but homes sit within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; cars park along it so some kerb room exists, but it is tight for a van.
drivers.convention: No signs; Esri shows a white van and cars parked here.

sun_shade: Dense canopy over most of the section; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Kerbside width for a 7 m van
